ownerModel.notes: Historical extra Codex routing is absorbed by Codex #1 under the current two-instance flow.

dynamicMcpFlow.evidence: Issue, PR, or runbook note records the requested tool and source.
Map requested scopes to read/suggest/create/update/delete/send/purchase/external_share plus managed-mcp high-risk scopes.
High-risk scopes require explicit CEO approval metadata before launch.
Prefer containerized MCP execution with least privilege, no host secrets, and no ambient writable mounts.
Record workflow run, issue comment, PR summary, or durable MCP audit row.
Fail closed or use a read-only documented fallback when the isolated launch is unavailable.

serverExecutionMatrix.executionForm: Docker MCP catalog read-only container preferred; hosted read-only connector fallback.
serverExecutionMatrix.auditLog: Issue/PR note with package, documentation source, and lookup summary.
serverExecutionMatrix.failureFallback: Use checked-in docs or skip lookup; do not fall back to unregistered host shell execution.

serverExecutionMatrix.executionForm: Supabase Edge Function MCP facade with container-smoke contract for local read-only MCP fixtures.
serverExecutionMatrix.auditLog: tools-hub MCP smoke workflow, schedule_task_runs row, and PR/issue validation note.
serverExecutionMatrix.failureFallback: Use tools-hub MCP smoke in GitHub Actions or leave feature_request.create disabled.

serverExecutionMatrix.executionForm: Containerized browser session or in-app browser with no credential entry unless explicitly approved.
serverExecutionMatrix.auditLog: Browser URL, screenshot or console evidence, and PR validation summary.
serverExecutionMatrix.failureFallback: Skip browser evidence and mark the validation gap in the PR when no isolated browser is available.

serverExecutionMatrix.executionForm: Read/draft connector only by default; outbound send is blocked until approval metadata is present.
serverExecutionMatrix.auditLog: Permalink/thread reference, explicit user approval, and issue/PR note before any outbound action.
serverExecutionMatrix.failureFallback: Keep draft local and do not send.

serverExecutionMatrix.executionForm: Denied as direct MCP. Use reviewed Supabase scripts, GitHub Actions, or explicit runbook instead.
serverExecutionMatrix.auditLog: Denied request is recorded in issue/PR notes; no production credential is exposed to MCP.

pocLaunch.executionForm: Local stdio MCP fixture in Docker Compose.
pocLaunch.auditLog: mcp-container-isolation-smoke workflow summary plus PR/issue comment.
pocLaunch.fallback: If Docker is unavailable locally, run the Python fixture directly and require GitHub Actions smoke after merge.
